newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait share index falls in slight correction.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait share index falls in slight correction.

text.p: Kuwait shares fell 43.8 points to 2,202.3 in the week to Wednesday with the market adjusting after big rises in recent weeks, dealers said on Thursday.
"It is a normal decline after heated speculation drove some shares considerably upwards," said Nasser Bou-Resli, a portfolio manager at Coast Development said.
"Kuwait's market lacks strategy," he added. "Everyone wants to go up with the others and go down with them."

The daily average for value of traded shares fell to 50.9 million dinars ($168 million) from 82 million. Volume eased to a daily average of 190 million shares from 288 million, figures released by the Kuwait Stock Exchange on Thursday showed.
Thirty-six shares fell, 13 rose and 11 did not change.
"Some of the shares fell due to the general trend although, technically speaking, they should rise," said a dealer. "They will rise in the coming weeks when the market goes to normal."
Investment firms were the most active sector in terms of traded value with 106.3 million dinars, followed by property firms with 75.5 million and banks with 25.4 million.
Kuwait Real Estate, Investment Projects, United Realty, The International Investor, Commercial Bank and National Industries were among the most active shares.
Only nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Oman and Kuwait -- can trade on the exchange. Foreign residents can invest in mutual funds.
